title: Explore Victorian Public Library Statistics
text: overdue helps people learning data analysis investigate one question: ranking Victorian public library services change depending library usage measured? “library busiest?” sounds like one answer. total visits mostly reflect many people service covers, per-resident measures highlight libraries used heavily compared number people serve. package bundles three years library statistics, function calculates ranks six usage metrics, Shiny app comparing rankings change.

title: Explore Victorian Public Library Statistics
text: plv_services contains selected measures 52 Victorian public library services (including statewide total Vision Australia) 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25: municipal population, branch, mobile outreach visits, active borrowers, physical eBook loans, website visits program attendance. Source: Public Libraries Victoria, 2024-25 PLV Annual Statistical Survey: Final Datasets 2022-23 2024-25. Preparation: script data-raw/plv_services.R imports spreadsheet, matches columns name across three yearly sheets, recodes renamed services checks one row per service per year. Limitations: visits count events, unique people; branch visits exclude mobile, outreach online use; services report measure left ranking.

title: Victorian public library service statistics, 2022-23 to 2024-25 — plv_services
Victorian public library service statistics, 2022-23 to 2024-25 — plv_services
text: tibble 156 rows (52 services x 3 years) 11 columns: service Library service name. "Victoria (Total)" published statewide total "Vision Australia" statewide service people print disabilities; neither municipal library service. financial_year Financial year, factor levels "2022-23", "2023-24" "2024-25". municipal_population Residents council areas service covers. NA Vision Australia. state total also includes Unincorporated Victoria (950 people). branch_visits -person visits branch libraries. Counts visits, unique visitors, excludes mobile, outreach online use. mobile_visits Visits mobile library vehicles. outreach_visits Visits outreach programs delivered outside library branches. active_borrowers Members borrowed least year. physical_loans Loans physical items books DVDs. ebook_loans Loans ebooks. website_visits Visits library service's website. Counts visits, individual users. program_attendance Attendance library programs events.
